title: Partner discovery and LOI vault in docs/rbpc/ and backend/routers/

implementation_summary.goal: Establish partner discovery and Letter of Intent (LOI) vault in docs/rbpc/ and backend/routers/ with secure evidence register, consent, expiration dates, scope, and agreement checksums.

cryptographic_checksum_provenance.anti_pii_guard: Strictly prohibits raw biometric signatures, scanned citizen identity cards, personal phone numbers, or document data URIs/URLs in public repo and API payloads.

negative_abuse_guardrail.rule: Revoked or expired partnerships are never displayed as active partners.
negative_abuse_guardrail.public_discovery_filter: GET /api/v1/rbpc/partners strictly filters by status == 'active', consent_status in ('consented', 'verified_written_consent'), revoked_at is NULL, and expiration_date >= CURRENT_DATE.
negative_abuse_guardrail.fail_closed_direct_lookup: GET /api/v1/rbpc/partners/{identifier} raises HTTP 404 NOT FOUND (RBPC_PARTNER_INACTIVE) if the partner agreement is expired or revoked.
negative_abuse_guardrail.immediate_revocation_exclusion: Revoking an agreement via POST /api/v1/rbpc/admin/loi-vault/{loi_id}/revoke instantly drops the partner from active discovery.

export_facilities.markdown_export: Formatted table suitable for RBPC 2026 pitch review and diligence exhibits.
export_facilities.json_export: Structured JSON payload with metadata and agreement checksums.
